# ten4seven UI agent index

## Start here

- `AGENTS.md` — short root rules and retrieval order.
- `docs/ai/AI_QUICKSTART.md` — two-minute system orientation.
- `docs/ai/APPLY_TO_EXISTING_WEB.md` — business-logic-safe migration workflow.
- `docs/ai/NEW_PROJECT.md` — greenfield sequence.
- `docs/ai/COMPONENT_SELECTION.md` — high-frequency component decisions.
- `docs/ai/THEMING.md` — public provider and typography contract.
- `packages/contracts/src` — typed contract source for ThemeProfile, recipes,
  aliases, and ownership.
- `generated/agent-index.json` — compact retrieval order and migrated entry
  points.
- `skills/ten4seven-ui/SKILL.md` — reusable agent workflow.

## FOUNDATIONS

- `packages/tokens/src/theme.ts` — axes, semantic typography roles, and variable generation.
- `packages/tokens/src/theme.css` — local Inter variable font and global token CSS.
- `packages/ui/src/provider.tsx` — provider and runtime theme propagation.
- `packages/ui/src/components.tsx` — canonical React primitives.
- `packages/ui/src/blocks.tsx` — reusable expressive blocks and public shell
  compositions built from canonical contracts.
- `packages/icons/src/index.tsx` — local semantic icon boundary.

## SHELL GRAMMAR

`AppShell → [Sidebar | TopNavigation | NavigationMenu] → [PageHeader] → bounded route content`

- `Sidebar` / `SidebarGroup`: private, information-dense applications.
- `PublicShell` + `NavigationMenu`: public, content, and commerce composition; `TopNavigation` remains the flat-link option.
- `PageHeader`: one route-level title, context, and primary action.
- `Drawer` / `DetailDrawer`: contextual inspection; `Modal`: focused task; `AlertDialog`: irreversible confirmation.
- Use `MobileSidebar` and `FilterDrawer` to relocate secondary controls at narrow widths. Do not create a second mobile or commerce primitive family.

## AI CATALOGS

- `generated/recipes.compact.json` and `generated/components.compact.json` —
  agent-facing default projections; read these first.
- `generated/aliases.json` and `generated/ownership-rules.json` — canonical
  alias and ownership decisions.
- `packages/ai/catalog/recipes.json` — page archetypes, shell selection,
  component composition, and required/recommended/optional block roles; use as
  the full fallback for recipes not yet migrated to typed decision contracts.
- `packages/ai/catalog/components.json` — searchable component contracts.
- `packages/ai/catalog/blocks.json` — expressive block contracts, quality
  metadata, content slots, and recipe references.
- `packages/ai/catalog/icons.json` — semantic icon lookup; provider names are implementation detail.
- `packages/ai/templates/AGENTS.ten4seven.md` — copy into consuming repositories.

## COMPONENT LEVELS AND TAXONOMY

Use the catalog's level metadata instead of treating every entry as the same
kind of component:

- L0 Foundations: provider, typography, icons, and token runtime.
- L1 Primitives: actions, forms, navigation, layout, surfaces, date/time,
  files, media, and charts.
- L2 Components: data display, tables, filtering, overlays, feedback, and
  commerce building blocks.
- L3 Patterns: reusable compositions such as AppShell, ActionFooter,
  CartPanel, and OrderSummary.
- L4 Blocks: reusable expressive sections such as Hero, FeatureShowcase,
  ProductShowcase, Carousel, and PublicFooter.
- L5 Recipes: page composition contracts such as `entity-list`, `catalog`,
  `cart`, and `checkout`.
- L6 References: Operations Tracker, Publishing Store, and Public Showcase
  proof screens.

Canonical family routes are `/components/patterns`, `/components/tables`, and
`/components/filtering-bulk-actions`. Older `/components/application`,
`/components/tables-filtering`, and `/components/charts` paths remain accepted
as compatibility routes.

## COMPONENTS

- actions: `Button`, `IconButton`, `ButtonGroup`, `ToggleButtonGroup`, `SplitButton`
- forms: `Field`, `Input`, `Textarea`, `Select`, `Combobox`, `MultiSelect`, `DatePicker`, `NativeTimeInput`, `TimePicker`, `FormSection`
- layout/navigation: `AppShell`, `Sidebar`, `TopNavigation`, `NavigationMenu`, `PublicShell`, `Breadcrumb`, `Tabs`, `CommandMenu`, `PageHeader`
- surfaces: `Card`, `Surface`, `Panel`, `Section`, `Typography`
- data: `Table`, `TableHeader`, `TableBody`, `TableRow`, `TableHead`, `TableCell`, `DataTable`, `DataTableColumnPicker`, `RecordSummary`, `MetricCard`, `ActivityFeed`, `StatusChip`
- filtering/workflow: `FilterToolbar`, `AppliedFilters`, `FilterDrawer`, `BulkActionBar`, `ApprovalPanel`, `ActionFooter`
- overlays/feedback: `Drawer`, `Modal`, `DetailDrawer`, `AlertDialog`, `Popover`, `Tooltip`, `Toast`, `StateView`, `Skeleton`
- commerce/media: `ProductGrid`, `ProductCard`, `Price`, `Rating`, `QuantityControl`, `CartTrigger`, `CartLineItem`, `CartPanel`, `OrderSummary`, `MediaFrame`, `Image`
- charts/files: `LineChart`, `BarChart`, `DonutChart`, `Progress`, `FileUpload`
- expressive compositions: `Hero`, `CtaBlock`, `FeatureShowcase`,
  `StatsSection`, `LogoCloud`, `Testimonials`, `PricingSection`,
  `ContentShowcase`, `ProductShowcase`, `Carousel`, `ChartPanel`,
  `PublicShell`, `PublicFooter`

Catalog status is exact: use only `implemented` components in production composition. A donor lookup is a design-system gap event: canonical package → AAPM extraction → one bounded donor lookup only if still missing → normalize into ten4seven → update catalog, AI contract, and provenance. Consumer code never imports a donor component.

## CLI

- `pnpm t7ui info`
- `pnpm t7ui find "operations tracker work queue"`
- `pnpm t7ui show DataTable`
- `pnpm t7ui recipe inspect entity-list`
- `pnpm t7ui compose entity-list`
- `pnpm t7ui agents init`
